data.name: Narmeen
data.gender_notes: Narmeen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Narmeen is derived from the Arabic word 'Nur' which means 'light'. The addition of 'Meen' refers to the moon. The name signifies the light of the moon and is a reminder of the peace and tranquility it brings. The name Narmeen carries the meaning “Light of the moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Narmeen usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Narmeen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of the moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Narmeen total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: نرمين
in_arabic.long_meaning: نرمين هو اسم عربي مشتق من الجذر 'رَمَينَ'، والذي يُشير إلى الماء النقي والهدوء والسكينة والجمال. ويُعتبر اسمًا متشابكًا بين الجاذبية الطبيعية والروحانية، كما يُشير إلى الشخصية الناعمة والرقيقة. ويُستخدم هذا الإسم في القرآن الكريم، حيث يُذكَر في سورة القصص (9:11) على إحدى الشخصيات الرئيسية. يُعتبر اسم نرمين من أشهر الأسماء في العالم الإسلامي، ويُستخدم بشكل واسع في مختلف الثقافات الإسلامية، بما في ذلك العربية والفارسية والتركية.

in_english.name: Narmeen
in_english.meaning: pure water, health, serenity, tranquility, beauty
in_english.long_meaning: Narmeen is an Arabic name derived from the root 'r-m-n,' which signifies 'pure water,' 'health,' 'serenity,' 'tranquility,' and 'beauty.' It is a name that symbolizes the qualities of purity, health, and beauty, much like water. The name is also associated with the concept of 'sakinah' or 'serenity,' which is a state of being that is characterized by peace and calmness. In Islamic tradition, the name Narmeen is considered to be a blessed name, and it is often given to children born into Muslim families.
